query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.categoryId,
  c.name as categoryName,
  p.subcategoryId,
  sc.name as subcategoryName
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id
LEFT JOIN subcategories sc ON p.subcategoryId = sc.id
LIMIT 10
